description: This Swift source file defines the CameraCaptureService actor responsible for managing camera and microphone access, capturing photos, and recording videos on macOS. It includes methods for listing devices, snapping photos, clipping videos, and handling camera setup, errors, and export operations. The file also declares supporting classes for handling photo and video capture delegates.

classes.name: PhotoCaptureDelegate
classes.description: Handles photo capture results, resumes continuation with photo data or errors.

classes.name: MovieFileDelegate
classes.description: Handles video recording completion, resumes continuation with output URL or errors.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of available camera devices with their info.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo from the specified camera device with options for facing, size, quality, and delay.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a video clip with options for facing, duration, audio inclusion, and output path.
